nodes.name: Watch Google Drive Folder
nodes.notes: Polls every 5 minutes for new files in the designated folder. Set GDRIVE_FOLDER_ID in env.

nodes.name: Download File from Drive
nodes.notes: Downloads the full file binary. This is the original quality file that will be sent later.

nodes.name: Is Video?
nodes.notes: Routes videos and photos down different paths. Videos get keyframe extraction; photos get HEIC conversion check.

nodes.name: Extract Photo Metadata
nodes.notes: Extracts metadata, checks for HEIC format, generates idempotency key.

nodes.name: Extract Video Metadata
nodes.notes: Tags file as video. Actual keyframe extraction happens in Workflow 2.

nodes.name: Save to Media Cache
nodes.notes: Saves original file to the shared media_cache Docker volume. This is what gets sent via WhatsApp.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO media_files (
  gdrive_file_id,
  original_filename,
  mime_type,
  file_size_bytes,
  local_path,
  taken_at,
  camera_model,
  gps_latitude,
  gps_longitude,
  is_video,
  idempotency_key,
  status
) VALUES (
  '{{ $json._asp.gdriveFileId }}',
  '{{ $json._asp.originalFilename }}',
  '{{ $json._asp.mimeType }}',
  {{ $json._asp.fileSize || 0 }},
  '/home/node/media_cache/{{ $json._asp.gdriveFileId }}_{{ $json._asp.originalFilename }}',
  {{ $json._asp.takenAt ? "'" + $json._asp.takenAt + "'" : "'" + $json._asp.driveTimestamp + "'" }},
  {{ $json._asp.cameraModel ? "'" + $json._asp.cameraModel + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json._asp.gpsLat || 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json._asp.gpsLng || 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json._asp.isVideo }},
  '{{ $json._asp.idempotencyKey }}',
  'pending'
)
ON CONFLICT (gdrive_file_id) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id;

nodes.name: Insert to Database
nodes.notes: Inserts media record. ON CONFLICT prevents duplicates if the same file triggers twice.

nodes.name: Trigger Processing Workflow
nodes.notes: Fires Workflow 2 (Process) asynchronously. Set WORKFLOW_PROCESS_ID env var to the Process workflow ID.

nodes.name: Error Handler
nodes.notes: Catches any error in this workflow and can send an alert.

nodes.name: Send Error Alert
nodes.notes: Posts error to a webhook. You can also configure this to send a WhatsApp message to yourself.
